The '''shipyards''' at [[Ord Trasi/Legends|Ord Trasi]] were a major [[Starship/Legends|starship]] construction facility controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], they were tasked by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] with constructing new [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] from his [[Thrawn's fleet (Galactic Empire)|fleet]].
